title: SecOps-NG Effectiveness Drift Record (SKELETON)
description: Typed shape for one drift record produced when the effectiveness drift detector diffs two successive effectiveness evidence snapshots in the same `(workflow_id, subject_version)` series. SKELETON in this card: the field inventory is pinned, but no detector implementation is shipped and no per-target compiler hook is wired — those land in the F-CP-06 EXTEND-drift CORE-FANOUT sibling. The five delta kinds (`metric_added`, `metric_removed`, `value_regressed`, `threshold_crossed`, `source_shape_changed`) are the surface NIS2 Article 21(2)(f) periodic effectiveness assessment cares about. Public-bar artifact: metric and control identifiers stay catalogue-shaped, source-shape pointers stay public-bar-safe (no embedded sample payload), free-text notes stay role-shaped, and individual personal names are out of scope per AGENTS.md §3.

schema_version.description: Pinned schema version. Lets a consumer reject drift records produced under an older schema once breaking changes ship.

id.description: Stable per-record identifier. Convention: SHA-256 hex digest of `<workflow_id>|<subject_version.value>|<previous_artifact_ref>|<current_artifact_ref>` (UTF-8, no separators around the pipes). Two detector runs against the same artifact pair collide deliberately.

stream.description: Identifies which evidence stream produced the drift record. Constant on this schema.

workflow_id.description: Stable workflow identifier — one of the workflow ids declared under `content/playbooks/<workflow-id>/`. The drift record always pins to a single workflow series; cross-workflow drift is intentionally out of scope.

subject_version.description: The thing whose effectiveness the two diffed snapshots evaluated against, pinned to a specific version. Mirror of `subject_version` on the effectiveness snapshot schema. The pair shares one subject version by construction; mixed-subject diffs are intentionally out of scope at this layer because they would conflate a version bump with an indicator movement.

kind.description: Mechanical classification of what is being versioned; mirror of `subject_version.kind` on the effectiveness snapshot schema.

value.description: Semver-shaped value (e.g. `1.2.0`) or a 64-hex content-hash; mirror of `subject_version.value` on the effectiveness snapshot schema. The deterministic-id derivation pins on this string verbatim.

previous_artifact_ref.description: `artifact_id` of the prior effectiveness evidence snapshot in this `(workflow_id, subject_version)` series. SHA-256 hex digest (64 chars).

current_artifact_ref.description: `artifact_id` of the current effectiveness evidence snapshot being compared against `previous_artifact_ref`. SHA-256 hex digest (64 chars). MUST differ from `previous_artifact_ref` — a drift record against an identical pair is not a drift record.

deltas.description: One entry per detected change between the two snapshots. An empty array is permitted: a deterministic detector that runs against a stable pair and finds no drift still produces a record so downstream consumers see the periodic effectiveness assessment walk happened.

detected_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the detector resolved this artifact pair. Format `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` (no sub-second precision, no offset — UTC only). Carries through to drift-aggregate rollups in the EXTEND-metrics sibling.

kind.description: Which drift surface this delta belongs to. The five-element vocabulary mirrors the surfaces NIS2 Art. 21(2)(f) periodic effectiveness assessment cares about and is promoted into `schemas/effectiveness_drift_kind.json` alongside the detector wiring. Extending the set is a discussion, not a drive-by change.

metric_ref.description: The KPI or KRI stable-id this delta is about. Mirror of `metric_ref` on the effectiveness snapshot schema. Reuses the `kpi.<slug>@v<semver>` / `kri.<slug>@v<semver>` namespace declared by content/metrics/*.yaml.

previous.description: Minimal snapshot of the fields relevant to `kind` on the previous side of the change. `null` for `metric_added`. Carries `{ value, unit, direction }` for `value_regressed` and `metric_removed`; `{ threshold }` for `threshold_crossed`; `{ source_shape }` for `source_shape_changed`. The operator-side regression-band table and the catalogue-side threshold-resolution table both live with the detector wiring; this schema only constrains shape, not vocabulary.

current.description: Minimal snapshot of the fields relevant to `kind` on the current side of the change. `null` for `metric_removed`. Carries `{ value, unit, direction }` for `value_regressed` and `metric_added`; `{ threshold }` for `threshold_crossed`; `{ source_shape }` for `source_shape_changed`. The operator-side regression-band table and the catalogue-side threshold-resolution table both live with the detector wiring; this schema only constrains shape, not vocabulary.

note.description: Short free-text rationale field pinning the delta to its inputs. Read by reviewers; not parsed downstream. No individual contact names; role-shaped owner identifiers only, mirroring the effectiveness SCHEMA `owner.role` discipline.

value.description: Numeric value the indicator took on this side; mirror of `measurement.value` on the effectiveness snapshot schema. Carried on `metric_added` / `metric_removed` / `value_regressed` deltas so the deltas are self-describing without re-walking the anchor snapshots.

unit.description: Unit of the value on this side; mirror of `measurement.unit` on the effectiveness snapshot schema. Carried on `metric_added` / `metric_removed` / `value_regressed` deltas.

direction.description: Which direction is better on this side; mirror of `measurement.direction` on the effectiveness snapshot schema. Carried on `metric_added` / `metric_removed` / `value_regressed` deltas so a downstream consumer can render the regression without re-walking the catalogue.

threshold.description: Catalogue-defined threshold tier the measurement rolls into on this side. Carried on `threshold_crossed` deltas. The implicit `none` value is used when no threshold was crossed; `warn` / `breach` / `critical` mirror the catalogue's `thresholds[].name` vocabulary.

source_shape.description: Source-shape pointer on this side; mirror of `measurement.source_shape` on the effectiveness snapshot schema. Carried on `source_shape_changed` deltas. The underlying sample payload is deliberately not embedded — the source-shape pointer is the public-bar-safe surface, and personal data in the underlying sample is out of scope per AGENTS.md §3.

kind.description: Which source-shape vocabulary the pointer reads against; mirror of `measurement.source_shape.kind` on the effectiveness snapshot schema.

ocsf_class_uid.description: OCSF event-class identifier. Optional, carried when `kind == ocsf`; absent otherwise. The full OCSF envelope (`class_name`, `ocsf_version`) lives on the anchor effectiveness snapshot; the drift sideSnapshot carries only the discriminating uid.

telemetry_ref.description: Long-form telemetry URN; mirror of `measurement.source_shape.telemetry_ref` on the effectiveness snapshot schema. Optional, carried when `kind == telemetry`; absent otherwise.
